name: Hugo
description: Basic SD Hyper model and 'dense diffusion' style regional prompting.

variables.name: Adherence
variables.description: How much to follow model geometry via ControlNet depth.

variables.name: Mask Softness
variables.description: How much to soften material prompt masks—softer masks apply to wider areas; harder ones are more constrained.

provenance.attribution: Created by RunDiffusion in collaboration with Team Juggernaut (Kandoo) - Juggernaut X Hyper (v10) SFW/SAFE checkpoint for SDXL.
provenance.data_provenance_notes: RunDiffusion describes Juggernaut X Hyper as trained 'from the ground up' using a GPT-4 Vision captioning tool by LEOSAM, with an expanded/cleaner dataset and improved shot classifications. The model card lists SDXL 1.0 (stabilityai/stable-diffusion-xl-base-1.0) as the base model. Specific training dataset sources are not disclosed.

provenance.data_provenance_notes: Stability AI Control-LoRA depth (rank 128): low-rank finetuning of ControlNet for depth-guided generation. Trained on MiDaS dpt_beit_large_512 depth maps and further fine-tuned using ClipDrop's Portrait Depth Estimation outputs.
